CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  WELCOMES YOU TO A REGULAR
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  August 08, 2023

Meetings begin at 6:00 pm with the conduct of any business permitted to be conducted in
closed session by the Brown Act (Government Code Section 54950, et seq.), if any, and with
the public portion of the meeting beginning at 7:00 pm. There is a period for public comment
on closed session matters at 6:00 pm prior to the closed session. In the event there is no
business to be conducted in closed session, the regular meeting shall begin at 7:00 pm.
There is a public comment period at the beginning of the regular meeting. Any person
wishing to comment shall be allotted three minutes per distinct item. Any meeting may be
adjourned to a time and place stated in the order of adjournment.

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting on the City’s website and outside of City
Hall. The agenda and related reports are also available for review online at
www.cityofsignalhill.org.

To view or listen to the meeting live at 7:00 p.m.:

  •  City of Signal Hill website at www.cityofsignalhill.org, select the City Council
  Meetings Link from the home page.
  •  Charter Spectrum Channel 3 or Frontier FiOS Channel 38.
  •  Call (408) 638-0968 (audio only) and enter meeting ID: 881-4793-6648, press #
  when prompted to provide participant ID, and enter passcode: 374778. If you would
  like to make a public comment, please notify the meeting host by pressing *9 on the
  telephone keypad.
To view and participate (closed session at 6:00 p.m. and regular meeting at 7:00 p.m.):

  • In-person Participation: Council Chambers of City Hall, 2175 Cherry Avenue, Signal
  Hill, California.
  • Remote Participation: Visit https://zoom.us/j/88147936648 on your desktop
  computer or laptop and enter passcode: 374778; or
  • Visit www.zoom.us on your desktop computer or laptop, click on “Join a Meeting”,
  and enter meeting ID: 881-4793-6648 and passcode: 374778 when prompted; or
  • Download the app from the app store if you are using a smart phone and enter
  meeting ID: 881-4793-6648 and passcode: 374778 when prompted.

  Page 1 of 7
 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

  • Please note that you will be placed in a “listen only” mode and your video feed will
  not be shared with the Council or public. If you would like to make a public comment,
  please notify the meeting host by raising your virtual hand (see hand icon at bottom of
  screen) and you will be invited to speak when the City Council is taking public
  comments. Please do not simultaneously use a microphone through Zoom and a
  cellphone/telephone. That combination results in audio problems for all participants.
  • To make a general public comment or comment on a specific agenda item, you may
  also submit your comment, limited to 250 words or less, to the City Clerk at
  cityclerk@cityofsignalhill.org not later than 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, August 8, 2023.
  Written comments will be provided electronically to City Council and attached to the
  meeting minutes. Written comments will not be read into the record.
  • Please note that remote participation is offered as a public service and the City is
  not responsible for meeting disruptions or technical difficulties; however, if you are
  disconnected, please repeat the steps above. Submission of written comments or
  in-person participation will ensure that your comments are received.
City Council Members are compensated $722.18 per month. City Clerk and City Treasurer are
compensated $438.22 per month.

  VICE MAYOR WOODS

 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

(10)  COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENTS

(11)  PRESENTATION

  a.  THE PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR WILL INTRODUCE MALINDA MITCHELL,
  PUBLIC WORKS ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT AND RYAN HEIGHES,
  FLEET SERVICES SUPERVISOR FOR THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL.

(12)  CITY MANAGER REPORTS

  a.  CONTRACT SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH STUDIO SPECTRUM, INC. FOR
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER AUDIO VISUAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

  Summary:

  The City Council will consider entering into a new Contract Services Agreement
  with Studio Spectrum, Inc. (Studio Spectrum) to purchase and install new video
  hardware and broadcast systems, City Council Chamber and control room
  equipment, and provide streaming video services, including closed captioning,
  for a not-to-exceed amount of $198,088.79, in a form approved by the City
  Attorney; and authorize the City Manager to approve a contingency in the
  amount not to exceed 10%.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize the City Manager to enter into a three-year Agreement with Studio
  Spectrum to purchase and install new video hardware and broadcast systems,
  City Council Chamber and control room equipment, and provide streaming
  video services, including closed captioning, for a not-to-exceed amount of
  $198,088.79, in a form approved by the City Attorney; and authorize the City
  Manager to approve a contingency in the amount not to exceed 10%.
  b.  OVERVIEW OF THE SIGNAL HILL LEADERSHIP ACADEMY

  Summary:

  The City Manager’s office developed the Signal Hill Leadership Academy
  (SHLA) to provide community members with an opportunity to gain in-depth
  insight into the workings of local government. This new community engagement
  initiative consists of a four-week leadership program aimed at providing
  community members with a comprehensive understanding of City government
  and encouraging active civic engagement. Through this academy, the City
  strives to make City functions more transparent and accessible to our Signal Hill
  residents and community members. SHLA will run for four weeks, commencing
  on Thursday, September 28, 2023, and concluding with a graduation ceremony
  at the City Council meeting of Tuesday, October 24, 2023.
  Recommendation:

  Receive and file.

  Page 3 of 7
 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

(13)  CONSENT CALENDAR

  The following Consent Calendar items are expected to be routine and
  non-controversial. Items will be acted upon by the Council at one time without
  discussion. Any item may be removed by a Council Member for discussion.
  a.  RESOLUTION DECLARING FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE SPRING STREET
  BICYCLE LANE GAP CLOSURE PROJECT (PROJECT NO. 90.18003)
  PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH SEQUEL
  CONTRACTORS, INC.

  Summary:

  Sequel Contractors, Inc. (SCI) completed the work for the Spring Street Bicycle
  Lane Gap Closure Project (“Project”), to the satisfaction of the Public Works
  Department and in accordance with the project plans and specifications. The
  Project was funded by a federal Active Transportation Plan Grant and included
  various improvements to the public right-of-way on Spring Street between
  Atlantic Avenue and Junipero Avenue including pavement rehabilitation, addition
  of new Class II bicycle lanes, street lighting, and other improvements. The final
  cost of the construction contract with SCI was $1,899,150.49. Staff is
  recommending final acceptance of the work performed by SCI and issuance of
  final payment.
  Recommendations:

  1. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, DECLARING  WORK  TO  BE  COMPLETED  IN
  CONFORMANCE WITH THE PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE
  SPRING STREET BICYCLE LANE GAP CLOSURE PROJECT (PROJECT
  NO. 90.18003) IN THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL, IN ACCORDANCE WITH
  THE CONTRACT ENTERED INTO BETWEEN SEQUEL CONTRACTORS,
  INC. AND THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL.

  2. Authorize the Finance Department to release retention withheld from SCI on
  the project. The City may release the retention amount, totaling $94,958, 30
  days from the date the adopted resolution is recorded with the Los Angeles
  County, or 90 days after the last day of work on the project, whichever date
  occurs sooner.
  b.  AMENDMENT TO THE RIGHT-OF-ENTRY PERMIT FOR HERITAGE POINT
  PARK

  Summary:

  The City Council will consider authorizing the City Manager to execute the First
  Amendment to the Right-of-Entry Permit between the City of Signal Hill and the
  City of Long Beach related to a property generally located on the west side of
  Page 4 of 7
 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

  Cherry Avenue and south of East Burnett Street. The property is owned by the
  City of Long Beach and is being used as part of Heritage Point Park.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize the City Manager to execute the First Amendment to the
  Right-of-Entry Permit between the City of Signal Hill and the City of Long Beach,
  for a term of one year, in a form approved by the City Attorney.
  c.  CONTRACT AMENDMENT REGISTER DATED AUGUST 8, 2023

  Summary:

  The Contract Amendment Register is a listing of proposed contract amendments
  and project change orders eligible for streamlined processing based upon the
  following criteria as documented in the City’s Purchasing Policy:

  ·  Funds have been authorized as part of the adopted fiscal year Operating
  Budget.
  ·  Staff are satisfied with the goods/services received to date; and
  ·  City Manager reviewed and approved each amendment for streamlined
  processing.

  The contract amendments being presented for City Council consideration are as
  follows:

  Desi Alvarez dba MCM Management Co.: Project management services for Well
  10 Construction project (95.18011). Amendment No. 3 extends the term by four
  months through November 30, 2023, and increases compensation by $16,000.
  The revised total not-to exceed contract amount is $441,000.

  Project Partners, Inc.: Professional water utility consulting support services for
  the Water Superintendent. Amendment No. 2 increases compensation by
  $101,600. The revised total not-to-exceed amount is $201,600.

  AKM Consulting Engineers: On-call water engineering services for Temple
  Reservoir. Amendment No. 4 extends the term by one year through July 11,
  2024.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize the Contract Amendment Register dated August 8, 2023.
  d.  FEE WAIVER REQUEST FOR THE FRIENDS OF SIGNAL HILL LIBRARY
  BOOK SALE

  Summary:

  The Friends of Signal Hill Library (FOSHL) is proposing to host a book sale
  fundraiser event on Thursday, October 12, 2023. FOSHL is requesting a waiver

  Page 5 of 7
 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

  of fees for the use of Signal Hill Library Community Room, City staff costs, and
  supplies for the set up and breakdown of their book sale. Additionally, FOSHL is
  requesting permission to promote their event by hanging banners on the Signal
  Point Terrace and at Hill Street and Temple Avenue.
  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that City Council review and approve a waiver of fees for use
  of Signal Hill Library Community Room, City staff costs, supplies, and allow
  FOSHL to display their banners for book sale promotion.
  e.  FEE AND ALCOHOL PROHIBITION WAIVER REQUEST FOR THE SIGNAL
  HILL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION ANNUAL FUNDRAISING EVENT

  Summary:

  The Signal Hill Community Foundation (SHCF) is proposing to host its annual
  fall fundraiser event on Friday, October 13, 2023. SHCF is requesting a waiver
  of fees for the use of the Signal Point Terrace, including staff fees, and a waiver
  of the alcohol prohibition on City property and live music policy. The SHCF
  secured an off-site, private venue as its primary space for this event, and would
  like to secure the City venue as an alternate.
  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that City Council approve the request for the waiver of fees
  for use of the Signal Point Terrace, City staff costs, and supplies; and waive the
  policy to allow live music and alcohol on City property for this annual fundraising
  event.
  f.  WARRANT REGISTER DATED AUGUST 8, 2023

  Summary:

  The Warrant Register is a listing of all general disbursements issued since the
  prior warrant register and warrants to be released upon City Council approval.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize payment of the Warrant Register dated August 8, 2023.
  g.  APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES

  Summary:

  Regular Meeting of July 25, 2023.
  Recommendation:

  Approve the meeting minutes.

  Page 6 of 7
 City Council  Regular  August 8, 2023

(14)  COUNCIL AGENDA--NEW BUSINESS

  COUNCIL MEMBER WILSON
  COUNCIL MEMBER JONES
  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  VICE MAYOR WOODS
  MAYOR HANSEN
(15)  ADJOURNMENT

  Tonight’s meeting will be adjourned to the next regular meeting of the Signal Hill City
  Council to be held on Tuesday, August 22, 2023, at 7:00 p.m. (hybrid meeting format,
  including in-person, and video and teleconference participation options). Instructions to
  participate in the meeting will be provided on the meeting agenda.
CITIZEN PARTICIPATION

  Routine matters are handled most quickly and efficiently if contact is made with the City
  department directly concerned. However, if you would like to request that a matter be
  presented for City Council consideration, you may do so by writing to the City Council,
  City Clerk, or City Manager. The deadline for agenda items is 12 noon on the Tuesday
  preceding the Council and Agency meetings. The complete agenda, including back up
  materials is available on the City website on the Friday preceding the meeting.

  If you need special assistance beyond what is normally provided to participate in City
  meetings, the City will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
  Please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 989-7305 at least 48 hours prior to the
  meeting to inform us of your particular needs and to determine if accommodation is
  feasible.
